claim: Final conclusions are approved: aggregated hourly data and local processing are the authorized routes; export of raw 15-minute data remains prohibited.
evidence: SolCentro considers hourly data and local processing viable. It does not accept raw 15-minute export in the next phase.
The privacy assessment supports policy v1.0. For 2027, I recommend further automation of output controls, but not relaxing group-size minimums or purpose review.
